name: Rocher Suchard - Packwiz NeoForge
author: admin@calagopus.local
description: Installe NeoForge et synchronise les fichiers serveur depuis une source Packwiz a chaque demarrage.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl

curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
  "https://github.com/packwiz/packwiz-installer-bootstrap/releases/download/v0.0.3/packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar" \
  -o packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /home/container

# Configure heap percentages relative to the Java container memory limit.
JVM_INITIAL_RAM_PERCENTAGE="${JVM_INITIAL_RAM_PERCENTAGE:-25}"
JVM_MAX_RAM_PERCENTAGE="${JVM_MAX_RAM_PERCENTAGE:-75}"

if [[ ! "$JVM_INITIAL_RAM_PERCENTAGE" =~ ^([1-9]|[1-8][0-9]|90)$ ||
      ! "$JVM_MAX_RAM_PERCENTAGE" =~ ^([1-9]|[1-8][0-9]|90)$ ]]; then
    echo "JVM RAM percentages must be whole numbers between 1 and 90." >&2
    exit 1
fi
if (( JVM_INITIAL_RAM_PERCENTAGE > JVM_MAX_RAM_PERCENTAGE )); then
    echo "JVM initial RAM percentage must not exceed the maximum." >&2
    exit 1
fi

NEOFORGE_ARGS="libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/unix_args.txt"

if [ ! -f "${NEOFORGE_ARGS}" ]; then
    echo "Installing NeoForge ${NEOFORGE_VERSION}..."

    curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
      "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar" \
      -o neoforge-installer.jar

    java -jar neoforge-installer.jar --installServer
    rm -f neoforge-installer.jar
fi

echo "Synchronizing Packwiz from ${PACKWIZ_URL}..."
java -jar packwiz-installer-bootstrap.jar -g -s server "${PACKWIZ_URL}"

# Warn if custom JVM arguments explicitly override heap sizing.
if [ -f user_jvm_args.txt ] &&
   grep -Ev '^[[:space:]]*(#|$)' user_jvm_args.txt |
   grep -Eq -- '(^|[[:space:]])(-Xms|-Xmx|-XX:(InitialRAMPercentage|MaxRAMPercentage)=)'; then
    echo "WARNING: user_jvm_args.txt contains heap options that can override JVM RAM percentages." >&2
fi

echo "Starting NeoForge ${NEOFORGE_VERSION} (JVM heap: initial ${JVM_INITIAL_RAM_PERCENTAGE}%, max ${JVM_MAX_RAM_PERCENTAGE}%)..."
exec java \
  "-XX:InitialRAMPercentage=${JVM_INITIAL_RAM_PERCENTAGE}" \
  "-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=${JVM_MAX_RAM_PERCENTAGE}" \
  -Dterminal.jline=false \
  -Dterminal.ansi=true \
  @user_jvm_args.txt \
  @"${NEOFORGE_ARGS}" \
  nogui
EOF

chmod +x start.sh
printf 'eula=true\n' > eula.txt

variables.name: Packwiz URL
variables.description: URL HTTP(S) publique ou accessible depuis le noeud Calagopus, pointant directement vers pack.toml.

variables.name: Version NeoForge
variables.description: Version NeoForge du pack. Doit correspondre a la valeur neoforge de pack.toml.

variables.name: JVM Initial RAM Percentage
variables.description: Initial Java heap as a percentage of the container memory (whole number 1-90). Must not exceed JVM Max RAM Percentage.

variables.name: JVM Max RAM Percentage
variables.description: Maximum Java heap as a percentage of the container memory (whole number 1-90). Leave headroom for non-heap memory.
